goal: Implement the owner-approved API-25–28 one-run transaction that enables Kodi Unknown Sources and atomically installs only the verified repository.kodisetup archive before launching Kodi.
success_criteria: The operation requires a current TV-local STRICT_SETUP consent, visible storage permission, API 25–28, installed org.xbmc.kodi, a canonical profile, and conservative proof Kodi is not active.

The app revalidates the signed manifest and immutable downloaded archive, enforcing the exact manifest URL/hash, repository.kodisetup root/ID/version, bounded entry/expanded sizes and ratio, and rejection of traversal, absolute/backslash/drive/NUL/overlong/duplicate/case-colliding paths, encryption, links, devices, and extra roots.

One journaled same-filesystem transaction stages and verifies all bytes, atomically merges only addons.unknownsources=true and installs only repository.kodisetup, preserves conflicting existing state and refuses overwrite, and rolls back exact prior bytes on failure or interrupted recovery.
Every async callback rechecks consent epoch, security-scope digest, platform, Kodi identity/state, and transaction state immediately before writing or launching; Stop/revoke invalidates future work.
After commit the app launches only org.xbmc.kodi, where Bootstrap's separate scope-bound consent remains visible. API 29+ retains export and guided manual Kodi installation.

Focused tests cover consent/permission denial, profile absence, Kodi-active refusal, idempotency/conflict, archive attacks, fault injection/recovery, stale callbacks, scope change, launch failure, and modern-Android fallback.
primary_hypothesis: A manifest-bound, fixed-target, journaled transaction can safely place the Bootstrap add-on on owner-approved Android 9 without creating a general cross-app installer.
discriminating_check: Inject a failure at each stage/swap/restore boundary and prove the exact prior profile is restored, while any caller-controlled archive/path/ID or ambiguous Kodi state is rejected before mutation.

owner_approval.scope: Fixed repository.kodisetup auto-install on API25-28 under one local consent; no arbitrary installer or modern-Android bypass.
owner_approval.evidence: Owner explicitly requested automatic Unknown Sources and repository.kodisetup installation on 2026-08-01.

stop_conditions: The implementation needs caller-controlled input, Kodi database changes, force-stop/kill, shell/ADB/accessibility, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, or unattended Android APK installation.
Exact rollback cannot be proven for a fault-injected phase.
Kodi-not-running state or the canonical profile cannot be established conservatively.
